text:
lina-csm: FYI we've seen 3 intake leads flagged as 'SI partner' but none are getting owners. We need a deterministic routing + auto-release flow. Proposal ideas below.

tom-sales: Agreed. Draft rules: 1) Marketplace-originated (AWS/GCP/Azure) -> partner PM auto-assign 2) SI-warm intro -> co-owned (AE + SI) 3) ACV >= $200k -> sales-owned, SI tagged as delivery. We need a HubSpot `si_claim` boolean and `claim_owner` tag for workflow.

anna-partnerops: I can build the HubSpot workflow to set `si_claim` and call a webhook to our claim service. Who will host the webhook? eng-platform or deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: eng-platform owns the webhook infra. Ticket INF-842 created to add `/si/claim` endpoint and document payload.

kevin-si: SI note: require explicit opt-in on intake. If `si_consent = yes` then partners can claim. Also need account-domain mapping to avoid duplicates. Example CSV mapping: 

```
account,preferred_owner,claim_threshold
acme.com,atlas-si,0
bigbank.com,redwood-sales,100000
```

lina-csm: Two operational questions: 1) adjudication when multiple partners claim 2) partner SLA expectations.

tom-sales: For adjudication, partnerops runs a 24h window to reconcile; if no resolution, AE gets temporary claim. SLA: partners should acknowledge claims within 48h.

anna-partnerops: I'll draft an adjudication checklist (why conflict exists, revenue split, prior ownership), plus an automated domain lock to prevent simultaneous claims for the same account domain.

pete-legal: Legal quick note: webhook payload must not include PII. Intake must surface consent language: "I consent to share my info with SI partners" and partner access must be gated by CDA/NDA.

lina-csm: I'll add the consent checkbox to the intake form and update copy. I'll put a draft playbook in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PRT/pages/si-claim-flow

kevin-si: Also request an auto-release rule: partner claims but no activity (no notes/outreach) for 7 days -> release claim back to pool automatically. Stops stale holds.

anna-partnerops: Agreed. I'll own HubSpot workflow, auto-release timer, and adjudication checklist. Target: EOD Friday for first draft.

deploy-bot: INF-842 updated with spec + sample payload: https://issues.redwood/inc/INF-842. Tagging eng-platform and partnerops.

lina-csm: Summary/Action items: anna -> HubSpot workflow + adjudication checklist (EOD Fri); tom -> set 30m sync invite to finalize rules; pete -> update intake consent language and legal gating; kevin -> provide partner contacts & confirm auto-release; deploy-bot -> follow up INF-842. I'll consolidate into the playbook and post back here. :raised_hands:
